description: Updating an agenda item: a planner edits title, description, presenter or documents.
precondition: Meeting in a planning or running status; actor with the needed role.

cases.inputs: actor: S; itemId: I; input {Title: "New"; Description: ""}.
cases.log: Title changed, UpdatedAt set; agenda change "Updated" published.
preconditions: Meeting in status Draft; active Chair C, active Secretary S, active Member M on the roster.
Item I "Old" Pending.

cases.inputs: actor: Chair C; itemId: I; input {Title: "Renamed"}.
cases.log: Status, actual start time and position unchanged; Title changed.
preconditions: Meeting in status InProgress; active Chair C, active Secretary S, active Member M on the roster.
Item I is InProgress.

cases.inputs: actor: Secretary S; itemId: I; input {Title: "Fix typo"}.
preconditions: Meeting in status InProgress; active Chair C, active Secretary S, active Member M on the roster.
Item I is Done.

cases.inputs: actor: S; itemId: I; input {Title: "Same"; Description: "d"} (nothing differs).
cases.log: Nothing saved and no agenda event published.
preconditions: Meeting in status Draft; active Chair C, active Secretary S, active Member M on the roster.
Item I "Same" with description "d", no presenter, no documents.

cases.inputs: actor: S; itemId: I; input {Title: unchanged; Description: "b"}.
preconditions: Meeting in status Draft; active Chair C, active Secretary S, active Member M on the roster.
Item I has description "a".

cases.inputs: actor: Secretary S; itemId: I; input {Title: unchanged; PresenterId: M}.
cases.log: Presenter set; presenter notice for M queued after commit.
preconditions: Meeting in status Published; active Chair C, active Secretary S, active Member M on the roster.
Item I has no presenter.

cases.inputs: actor: Chair C; input {Title: unchanged; PresenterId: Secretary S}.
cases.log: Presenter changed to S; notice queued for S.
preconditions: Meeting in status InProgress; active Chair C, active Secretary S, active Member M on the roster.
Item I has presenter M.

cases.inputs: actor: S; input {Title: unchanged; PresenterId: null}.
preconditions: Meeting in status Published; active Chair C, active Secretary S, active Member M on the roster.
Item I has presenter M.

cases.inputs: actor: S; input {Title: unchanged; PresenterId: null}.
cases.log: Legacy presenter name cleared; saved even though title and description did not change.
preconditions: Meeting in status Published; active Chair C, active Secretary S, active Member M on the roster.
Item I has legacy free-text presenter name "Old Name".

cases.inputs: actor: S; input {Title: unchanged; DocumentIds: null} (omitted).
cases.log: Existing link to D1 kept; nothing saved when nothing else differs.
preconditions: Meeting in status Draft; active Chair C, active Secretary S, active Member M on the roster.
Item I linked to D1.

cases.inputs: actor: S; input {Title: unchanged; DocumentIds: [D2]}.
cases.log: Link set replaced: D1 unlinked, D2 linked.
preconditions: Meeting in status Draft; active Chair C, active Secretary S, active Member M on the roster.
Item I linked to D1; D2 also belongs to the meeting.

cases.inputs: actor: S; input {DocumentIds: []}.
preconditions: Meeting in status Draft; active Chair C, active Secretary S, active Member M on the roster.
